messages:
Kevin Ortiz: Heads up — PrimeBridge deal wants to run their custom adapter (quant-shim) on PB-13B. Can we confirm memory + latency impact and a rough bill of materials?
Maria Chen: Quick ask: do they need KV cache pinned per-tenant? that affects RAM a lot.
Alex Park: @Maria Chen they said yes to per-tenant KV for PII routing. estimate: +8–12GB RAM per replica depending on seq_len.
Sara Iqbal: Also need to know if quant-shim adds CPU postprocessing. any additional CPU/GPU kernels?
Alex Park: quant-shim is a light adapter shim (fp16->int8-friendly ops). GPU exec path stays same, but we add a small post-rollout CPU step for reformatting metadata (~1 core).
Kevin Ortiz: Can you give a short SLO impact note for the AE? they asked about 99th pct latency under 200ms for single-turn generation (512 tokens).
Alex Park: For 512 tokens with per-tenant KV and quant-shim: p50 ~55ms, p95 ~170ms p99 ~240ms on p4d-like hardware. With batching tuned to 8 you can hit p99 ~190ms but throughput adds tail risk.
Maria Chen: TL;DR for sales: if they want strict p99<200ms we should offer Dedicated pool with reserved replicas and smaller batch window.
Sales Ops: Pricing question from PrimeBridge: rough incremental $/token for using per-tenant KV + quant variant vs stock PB-13B?
Sara Iqbal: Rough calc: base hosted PB-13B $0.0006/token. With per-tenant KV, extra infra amortized ~+$0.00012/token at our expected QPS. quant variant reduces GPU token cost by ~15% -> net +$0.00002/token. so ballpark +$0.00014/token.
Kevin Ortiz: Great. They also submitted a security questionnaire — SSO + KMS + audit logs required. Any blockers for Private deployment?
Maria Chen: Private deployment supports customer KMS and SAML SSO. Audit logs available. Major blocker: their legal wants HSM-backed keywrap; we support KMS but HSM integration needs an enterprise add-on and timeline ~4 weeks.
Sales Ops: Flagging contract item and cost for HSM addon.
Alex Park: Technical preflight list I need filled from AE: 1) expected peak qps, 2) max sequence length, 3) whether streaming responses used, 4) adapter binary (wheel/container) and expected memory map.
Kevin Ortiz: AE said: peak 120 qps, max seq 2048, streaming yes, adapter provided as container image.
Maria Chen: 2048 seq_len will blow up KV memory. need to propose either prefix/truncation or shard KV. Also recommend enabling prefix caching to reduce repeated context.
Alex Park: Suggested deployment options: (A) Dedicated with 4 large GPUs + per-tenant KV per replica + reserved capacity. (B) Hosted with autoscale + fallback to PB-7B-quant for bursts. Pros/cons doc: A -> predictable latency/cost. B -> lower commitment but possible higher p99.
Kevin Ortiz: Can someone whip up a short one-pager for the AE and drop into the deal? include cost delta table and the HSM addon note.
Sara Iqbal: I'll draft cost delta table. quick snippet for the AE to run a latency probe:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"pb-13b-quant-shim","input":"<sample>"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq .latency
```
Maria Chen: FYI deploy-bot ran a quick compatibility check on the adapter image and returned warnings about glibc mismatch — needs rebuild with our base image.
deploy-bot: compatibility-scan: primebridge/quant-shim:tag -> WARNING: glibc 2.28 vs runtime 2.31; recommend rebuilding with redwood/base:2025-08.
Alex Park: That rebuild is quick. tell AE to get container replaced before test suite.
Sales Ops: Noted. AE asked about an ETA for an internal POC checklist and signoffs (security & infra).
Maria Chen: POC checklist ETA: 3 business days for infra config + 5 business days for security review if HSM add-on requested.
Kevin Ortiz: Perfect — I'll update the customer and loop in legal for HSM pricing. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Sara Iqbal: Dropping the cost delta draft here when ready.
Maria Chen: I'll follow up with the exact RAM numbers after we model the KV shards for seq=2048.
Alex Park: I'll schedule a quick 20m sync with the AE if they want to walk through the adapter changes.
Sales Ops: Filing deal note -> will attach one-pager and interim cost estimate.
Kevin Ortiz: Closing thread for now, will reopen if AE shares rebuilt image.
